summary: Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing an interest rate reset on its C$2 billion 3.375% Limited Recourse Capital Notes Series 1, effective for the five-year period from June 19, 2026 to June 19, 2031. The new rate is 5.883% per annum, calculated as the Government of Canada Yield plus 2.839%. Interest remains semi-annual, payable on June 19 and December 19. The notes mature June 19, 2081. This is a routine debt instrument adjustment with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, spin-off, restructuring, or other corporate action. The notes are subordinated indebtedness with limited recourse to shares held by a trust. As a routine interest reset on existing subordinated debt, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
